entities.name: PMID:25238210
observations: Observational cohort compared 60 robot-assisted partial nephrectomy patients with pathologically proven medical renal disease in non-neoplastic tissue versus 101 without it.
Percent GFR change was −8.8% versus −12.2% (p=0.194); CKD upstaging was 18.3% versus 39.6% (p=0.006).
Abstract reports similar length of stay, transfusion, and complication rates; full text and confidence intervals unavailable in retrieved evidence.
